notes.rubric_reuse: Before generation, retrieve up to eight related criteria from the committed cumulative KEEP bank and ask the semantic matcher whether applicability, Agent state, M/C, and all score boundaries are equivalent. Reuse an unchanged match without generator, Gate, or witness calls; generate and verify only when no equivalent criterion exists.
notes.scoring: After verification, freeze the updated bank for the five-case batch and score every bank criterion with shared-state applicability. Final scoring has no top-k cutoff.
